_comment: Copy to backends.json, fill in real keys, keep it OUT of git (see .gitignore). Order = failover priority. Each backend's model OVERRIDES what ARTEX sends; auth replaces the inbound Authorization header, so ARTEX's OPENAI_API_KEY can be a dummy. Failover is TRANSIENT-ONLY (429/5xx/timeouts) — safety refusals and config errors pass straight through to ARTEX.
